results.title: What does 'personal' mean?
results.content: It has to do with you, not politics, not math, and not what’s in some textbook. If I were your boss and fired you because I didn’t like you, that would be personal. If I fired you because you missed a lot of work days and made a lot of costly mistakes, that wouldn’t be personal.
